Establishes enterprise standards for learning at the point of need by advancing mobile-first learning experiences, microlearning strategies, and technology-enabled delivery methods that provide timely, accessible learning for associates across clinical and operational environment

DeSimone is a leading global structural engineering firm known for delivering innovative, high-performance design solutions across the built environment. Our team of engineers, designers, and technical experts collaborates on a diverse portfolio—from iconic high-rise buildings to complex, large-scale structures—shaping skylines and communities around the world. With offices across the U.S. and internationally, we partner closely with clients to bring bold ideas to life with precision, creativity, and technical excellence.

Why DeSimone?

At DeSimone Consulting Engineering, you’ll work alongside some of the world’s most brilliant engineering minds on projects that redefine skylines and push the boundaries of design and innovation. From iconic skyscrapers to cutting-edge structures, our global portfolio reflects a commitment to excellence and creativity.

We are a team that values growth, collaboration, and real impact—you won’t just be part of the work, you’ll help shape it. With strong mentorship, hands-on experience, and opportunities to advance, you’ll build a career as impressive as the projects you’re working on.

We offer a flexible, collaborative work environment along with a comprehensive benefits package—including medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and 401K —designed to support your well-being and long-term success.

At DeSimone, your contributions matter. You’ll be trusted with meaningful work, empowered to grow, and supported every step of the way.

Ready to build what’s next? Join us.

About The Role

The Project Manager oversees the structural design process from inception to construction, handling structural analysis, preparing plans and specifications, and reviewing contractor submittals and RFIs. This role involves problem-solving, decision-making, and directing the work of junior engineers and BIM technicians. The Project Manager coordinates with clients, architects, municipal agencies, and the design team, manages project schedules, forecasts workloads, and handles project communication and documentation. Technical responsibilities include designing and analyzing mid to high-rise buildings using software like ETABS, SAP, and RAM.

What You'll Do

Lead the structural design and analysis of mid- to high-rise buildings using industry-standard software including ETABS, SAP2000, and RAM.
Develop structural concepts, perform complex engineering analyses, and prepare design criteria for a variety of building projects.
Oversee project execution, ensuring designs meet applicable building codes, project requirements, and quality standards.
Review and coordinate structural designs with architects, owners, contractors, and other members of the design team.
Review shop drawings and construction submittals to verify compliance with design intent, technical requirements, and safety standards.
Identify project challenges, develop practical solutions, and guide project teams through implementation.
Lead client, consultant, and project team meetings and serve as a primary technical point of contact.
Monitor project schedules, budgets, and resource utilization to ensure successful project delivery.
Prepare technical reports, presentations, correspondence, and project documentation.
Provide quality control reviews and ensure accuracy and attention to detail across all project deliverables.
Mentor and supervise junior engineers, providing technical guidance and supporting professional development.
Assist with proposal preparation, project budgeting, fee development, and business development initiatives.
Build and maintain strong client relationships while supporting networking, marketing, and industry engagement efforts.
Collaborate across disciplines and offices to support project and company-wide goals.

What We're Looking For

Strong knowledge of structural engineering principles, building systems, materials, and construction methods.
Experience designing and analyzing building structures, preferably mid- to high-rise projects.
Proficiency with ETABS, SAP2000, RAM, and other structural analysis and design software.
Thorough understanding of applicable building codes, design standards, and industry best practices.
Ability to perform complex engineering analyses and develop practical, data-driven solutions.
Experience reviewing construction documents, shop drawings, and technical submittals.
Strong project management skills, including the ability to balance multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and maintain budgets.
Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work.
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including report writing, presentations, and client interactions.
Ability to build collaborative relationships with clients, architects, contractors, and internal teams.
Experience mentoring junior staff and contributing to a positive, team-oriented culture.
Business-minded approach with an understanding of project financial performance, budgeting, and resource management.
Interest in business development, networking, and growing client relationships.
A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong critical thinking and leadership abilities.

Minimum (Required) Qualifications

Bachelor of Science in Civil, Structural, or Architectural Engineering or related field; and ten (10) years of relevant work experience in structural analysis and design of mid to high-rise buildings, including project management; or
Master’s degree in Civil, Structural, or Architectural Engineering or related field; and eight (8) years of relevant work experience in structural analysis and design of mid to high-rise buildings, including project management.
Professional Engineer’s (PE) license.
Minimum 7 years of experience in performing and supervising the design and analysis of mid to high rise buildings.
Minimum 7 years of experience utilizing software packages such as ETABS, RAM, RISA, Rhino, PCA and SAFE.
Minimum 7 years of experience with wind tunnel testing process, applying wind tunnel loads to the lateral model, and supplemental damping strategies.

Minimum (Required) Skills

Proficient in Microsoft Office.
Extensive knowledge of local and national building codes and design practices.
Knowledge of standard construction practices and the ability to work with contractors to address construction issues.
Detail-oriented with strong interpersonal, problem-solving, and team skills.
Knowledge of ETABS, SAFE, Rhino, PCA or other similar design tools.
Ability to perform and supervise the design and analysis of mid to high rise buildings utilizing software packages such as ETABS, RAM, RISA, and SAFE.

Preferred Qualifications And Skills

Master’s Degree in Civil, Structural Engineering or related field.
Structural Engineer’s (SE) license.
Experience working in Grasshopper.
This position can be in either Boston or Foxborough, Massachusetts**

Company Description
FBD Vanguard Construction, Inc. is a Northern California-based general contractor established in 1997, with current operations based in Livermore, CA. The company has grown from a small Oakland office focusing on curb, gutter, ramp, and sidewalk work into a team of approximately 150 employees serving both public and private sector clients. Supported by a diverse fleet of equipment and machinery, FBD Vanguard manages small and large projects and can respond quickly to emergency work. Core specializations include various concrete pavement systems, concrete barriers, and minor concrete, including curb, gutter, and sidewalk construction.

This is a full-time, on-site role located in Livermore, CA for Project Managers, Superintendents, and Project Engineers. Team members will oversee civil and concrete construction projects from planning through completion, including scheduling, budgeting, and coordination of field activities. Responsibilities include supervising crews, ensuring work quality and safety compliance, managing subcontractors and suppliers, and maintaining clear communication with clients and internal stakeholders. The role involves reviewing project plans and specifications, tracking progress, resolving issues in the field, and supporting expediting of materials, equipment, and inspections. Daily tasks also include documentation of project activities, preparation of reports, and collaboration with logistics and operations to meet project timelines and standards.

Candidates should possess strong project management skills, including Project Management and Expediting experience.

Candidates should possess inspection and quality assurance skills, including experience with Inspection processes on construction projects.
Candidates should possess logistics management skills, including Logistics Management for coordinating equipment, materials, and site operations.
Experience in civil or concrete construction, preferably in both public and private sector projects.
Knowledge of construction safety standards and regulatory requirements; commitment to safe work practices.
Proficiency in construction scheduling and project documentation; familiarity with project management software is beneficial.
Strong communication, leadership, and team collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate field and office personnel.
